title: VISPA: Pluralistic Alignment via Automatic Value Selection and Activation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating pluralistic alignment by measuring a model's ability to reflect diverse cultural, moral, and non-WEIRD perspectives. This is assessed across three evaluation modes: Overton (using NLI to measure the coverage of diverse values in responses), Steerable (measuring the accuracy of conditioning outputs on specific values), and Distributional (calculating the Jensen-Shannon distance between model response distributions and empirical human public opinion/value distributions) on datasets like VITAL and ModPlural.
